registers.name: CFG_WORD_0
registers.description: Low byte of the 64-bit control/status window. Holds enable, soft_reset, mode, and status-clear policy bits.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable for request/response operation. When 0, request issuance is inhibited and safe fallback is maintained.

fields.name: SOFT_RESET
fields.description: Synchronous soft reset request sampled by the controller. Clears outstanding transaction state and returns to deterministic safe fallback.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: 3-bit mode select for compact operating policy. Mode is implementation-defined within the allowed safety wrapper behavior and does not change top-level protocol shape.

fields.name: STATUS_CLEAR
fields.description: Write-1-to-pulse status clear request for clearing sticky status bits that are software-managed.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of the programmable timeout threshold in cycles. Used by the timeout counter and fallback supervision.
